A '''Tyrian hydraulic strut'''<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|207|Dreddon the Hutt}}</ref> was a piece of technology that [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] used to fashion [[Air scoop/Legends|air scoops]] for [[Anakin Skywalker's Podracer/Legends|his podracer]].<ref name="CV2016">[[Star Wars: Complete Vehicles (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Vehicles'', 2016 edition]]</ref>
